sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Light Value-Added Postponement Packaging and Custom Kitting

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended, Sections 710-1 to 710-24 (Société à Responsabilité Limitée); Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies and Bookkeeping; Grand-Ducal Regulation of 23 January 2003 on the RCS; Law of 2 September 2011 on Access to Professions (establishment authorization).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) operating the Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS); notary public (notaire) as mandatory filing intermediary; publication in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Acte constitutif (notarial deed of incorporation) together with the legal statement of compliance (déclaration légale) deposited electronically by the notary with the RCS and published in the RESA.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum issued capital EUR 12,000; at least 25% (EUR 3,000) must be paid up before notarization and lodged in a blocked escrow bank account (compte bloqué) opened with a credit institution established in Luxembourg; the bank releases funds only upon presentation of the RCS registration certificate; the remaining 75% must be paid within five years. Contributions in kind require a statutory auditor's (réviseur d'entreprises) valuation report and are fully paid at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the incorporating shareholders adopt the Articles of Association of [Company] S.à r.l. as initialled and subscribe for the shares set opposite their names, subject to blocking of EUR 3,000 (25% of minimum capital) in a Luxembourg bank account. RESOLVED that the registered office is established at [address], Luxembourg, and the deed of incorporation be filed with the Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés and published in the RESA promptly. RESOLVED that [Name] is appointed manager (gérant) with sole signature authority, and is authorized to complete all filings, registrations, banking and licensing formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via the Guichet.lu online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request (certificat de non-usage) containing up to three proposed company names, the legal form (S.à r.l.), and the corporate purpose. The LBR verifies the absence of identity or confusion with existing registered names and issues a negative certificate valid for 60 days, which the notary later attaches to the deed.
required_dossiers: Name reservation form (formulaire de réservation de dénomination)
Copy of the identity documents of all founding shareholders
Proposed corporate object (objet social) for ISIC 5210 warehousing and fulfillment services
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused due to conflict, file a written reconsideration request with the LBR within 15 days or immediately reserve the next candidate name; a judicial remedy before the Tribunal d'arrondissement remains available in case of unlawful refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of blocked capital account and deposit of subscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Credit institution established in Luxembourg and licensed by the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a future-company bank account (compte d'attente) in the name of the S.à r.l. in formation and deposit at least EUR 3,000, representing 25% of the minimum share capital. Obtain the banker's blocking certificate (attestation de blocage) confirming the deposit and the irrevocable blocking until presentation of the RCS registration certificate.
required_dossiers: Draft articles of association
Identity and KYC documents of all shareholders and planned managers
Proof of source of funds and bank reference
Bank account opening and mandate forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises enhanced KYC requests, supply the additional documentation within the bank's deadline; if the account is ultimately declined, transfer the deposit to another CSSF-licensed Luxembourg bank. Blocked funds are released to subscribers if incorporation is abandoned.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the notarial deed of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary public (notaire) registered with the Chambre des Notaires du Luxembourg
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary reviews the articles, the capital blocking certificate, the criminal record extracts of the future managers, and the corporate purpose; the subscribers execute the acte constitutif before the notary, who verifies legal capacity and compliance and then files the deed with the RCS electronically within three working days.
required_dossiers: Final draft of the articles of association (statuts)
Bank capital blocking certificate (attestation de blocage)
Identity documents and criminal record extracts (casier judiciaire) of managers
Consent of the owner/lease of the registered office (siège social)
Name reservation certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies a legal defect, execute a rectifying deed (acte rectificatif) before the same notary; where the RCS raises observations, the notary resubmits the corrected filing within five days. Errors in the deed are cured retroactively by rectification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration at the RCS and publication in the RESA
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS); publication in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary files the signed incorporation deed, the legal statement of compliance, and the registered office acceptance with the RCS. The RCS registrar verifies legal conformity, assigns the national business identification number, and issues the registration extract (extrait du registre de commerce). The incorporation deed, the appointment of managers, and the registered office are published in the RESA.
required_dossiers: Notarial deed of incorporation (acte constitutif)
Legal statement of compliance signed by the notary
Registered office acceptance form (acceptation du siège social)
Power of attorney if a representative acts
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues an observation or query, submit a written response or correct the deed by notarial rectification within 15 days; a refusal may be appealed to the Tribunal d'arrondissement within three months of notification. Publication in the RESA is automatically performed by the RCS upon registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration tax, VAT, customs and social security registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT); Centre commun de la sécurité sociale (CCSS); Administration des douanes et accises (customs, if bonded warehousing is intended)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the RCS extract and the national business number, register for corporate income tax, municipal business tax (impôt commercial communal), and VAT at the AEDT; affiliate any first employees with the CCSS within eight days of hiring; if the fulfillment warehouse will operate as a customs warehouse, apply separately for customs warehouse authorization from the Customs Administration.
required_dossiers: RCS registration extract (extrait du registre de commerce)
Identity documents of the manager(s) and signature specimens
AEDT VAT and corporate tax registration forms
CCSS employer affiliation form
Optional customs warehouse authorization application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late filings are cured by immediate electronic retrospective declaration with payment of accrued duties, if any; a formal request for a discretionary waiver of late-filing penalties may be addressed to the AEDT or CCSS where force majeure is demonstrated. Objections must be lodged within three months of assessment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for the business establishment permit and municipal consents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministère de l'Économie – Direction générale PME et entrepreneuriat; municipal authority (collège des bourgmestre et échevins) of the commune of the registered facility
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the application for the autorisation d'établissement for the commercial/industrial activity under the Law of 2 September 2011, attaching proof of professional qualification or appointing a qualified manager. Apply with the commune for the building permit (permis de construire), the occupancy permit, and the fire safety dossier (dossier de sécurité incendie) before starting operations of the fulfillment and kitting facility.
required_dossiers: Establishment authorization application form
Criminal record and diplomas or professional experience certificates
Lease title or ownership deed of the warehouse facility
Fire safety dossier approved by the Corps grand-ducal d'incendie et de secours (CGDIS)
Building permit and municipal occupancy permit
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Under the Law of 2 September 2011, the establishment permit is deemed granted if the Ministry does not decide within three months (silence is acceptance); an administrative appeal against a refusal must be lodged with the Minister of the Economy within 40 days, followed by an appeal to the Administrative Tribunal within three months of the ministerial decision.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministère de l'Économie – Direction générale PME et entrepreneuriat (business establishment permit); Administration de l'environnement (environmental compliance); Inspection du travail et des mines (ITM) for occupational safety; communal authorities for planning and fire safety.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sector-specific statutory license applies to ISIC 5210 third-party logistics, kitting and assembly activities (Low_Risk_Standard, no banking or AML license). The general Autorisation d'établissement (establishment permit) under the amended Law of 2 September 2011 is nevertheless a condition precedent to operating a commercial warehouse in Luxembourg, together with municipal building and occupancy permits.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B – simplified environmental screening (notice d'impact) required where the warehouse/logistics floor area exceeds the thresholds of Annex II of the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 15 May 2018 implementing the Law of 15 May 2018 on environmental impact assessment; sites located in sensitive zones (Natura 2000, water catchments) are also screened. Facilities below the thresholds are exempt and require only registration; a full EIA (étude d'impact) is not triggered for light kitting, packaging and fulfillment operations below Annex I thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: compliance with the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 3 June 1994 on wastewater discharge into municipal sewers, including limits for COD, BOD5, suspended solids and pH, plus communal sewer regulations. Volatile organic compounds: solvent consumption below 2 t/yr keeps the facility outside the industrial emissions permit thresholds of EU Directive 2010/75/EU; above the threshold, Annex VII emission limit values and the Luxembourg IED implementing rules apply. Waste: segregation, recovery and reporting obligations under the Law of 21 March 2012 on waste management and the packaging waste Grand-Ducal Regulation, including Valorlux-registered take-back schemes and the national waste register.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety dossier (dossier de sécurité incendie) approved by the communal authority with prior technical advice of the Corps grand-ducal d'incendie et de secours (CGDIS), covering means of egress, fire compartments, suppression systems and emergency lighting; structural load verification certificate for racking, mezzanines and high-bay shelving issued by an agréé engineering office (bureau d'études agréé) under the Law of 30 July 2013 on land use planning and building; registration with the Inspection du travail et des mines (ITM) and completion of the mandatory professional risk assessment (évaluation des risques) under the Law of 17 June 1994 on occupational health and safety, including first-aid, emergency evacuation plan, and workplace signage; certificate of conformity for electrical installations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT and customs matters; Administration des contributions directes (ACD) for corporate income tax; Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS Luxembourg) for statutory registration; Guichet.lu / MyGuichet as the central electronic filing portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity establishing a Luxembourg SARL or branch must first complete notarial incorporation and file the statutes with the RCS Luxembourg via Guichet.lu, thereby obtaining the Luxembourg business registration number (matricule). The matricule is automatically the national identification number for tax purposes. VAT identification must then be applied for with the AEDT, which issues a Luxembourg VAT number in the format LU plus the 11-digit matricule. The entity must also obtain an EORI number for customs operations. Registration applications may be filed electronically through MyGuichet with certified copies of constitutive documents and management appointments.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box regime exists for Luxembourg SARLs. A SARL is fiscally opaque. Available statutory elections include Luxembourg group taxation (intégration fiscale) under Article 164bis LIR for resident companies held directly or indirectly at 95%, and the VAT group election under Article 60 of the VAT law allowing an 'assujetti unique' single taxable person election. Hybrid mismatch transparency elections are not generally available to an ordinary SARL.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual taxable turnover for Luxembourg-established small taxpayers claiming the small enterprise exemption; non-established foreign suppliers have no general turnover threshold and are required to register for Luxembourg VAT when they make a taxable supply of goods or services in Luxembourg, or when they trigger EU distance/remote-sales thresholds requiring OSS registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Luxembourg does not currently impose mandatory real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction controls, or digital stamping for domestic B2B invoicing. Electronic invoicing is legally valid and accepted under standard EU VAT invoice rules. VAT returns must be filed electronically through MyGuichet/EED. Luxembourg is monitoring EU ViDA proposals for mandatory B2B e-invoicing; no immediate API clearance requirement is in force.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods may be zero-rated where they are physically exported from Luxembourg to a destination outside the EU customs territory and the export customs declaration has been accepted and released. Intra-Community supplies of goods to taxable persons in another EU Member State may also be zero-rated when the customer supplies a valid EU VAT identification number and the goods are dispatched or transported to that Member State. For services, including warehouse/kitting and handling services ancillary to exported goods, zero-rating applies where the service is supplied to a customer established outside the EU or genuinely relates to goods exported outside the EU. Full documentary evidence must be held within the statutory period before the VAT return is filed.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD/ECS with Movement Reference Number)
Bill of Lading, CMR road consignment note or Air Waybill evidencing physical export
Inward Remittance Certificate or equivalent bank SWIFT/credit evidence for foreign exchange repatriation
Commercial invoice and detailed packing list
Proof of customer's EU VAT identification number for intra-Community supplies
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The AEDT may reject zero-rating and retrospectively reassess VAT at 17% if export substantiation is incomplete, inaccurate, or fraudulent. Default interest accrues at 0.6% per month. Administrative fines may be imposed up to EUR 5,000 or more depending on gravity, plus denial of input VAT deduction and clawback of any refunded VAT. Criminal prosecution for serious VAT fraud may result in additional fines and imprisonment. Documents must be retained and made available for audit scrutiny; retrospective clawbacks extend to the full statutory limitation period under Luxembourg VAT law.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL) acts as the monetary authority and TARGET2 settlement agent; the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) supervises credit institutions and enforces AML/CFT obligations. Luxembourg maintains no dedicated foreign-exchange control administration, reflecting the EU free-movement-of-capital regime under Article 63 TFEU and Directive 88/361/EEC.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Fully convertible regime. Luxembourg imposes no exchange controls on current-account or capital-account transactions, and the euro and all freely convertible currencies may be moved in and out without prior BCL or CSSF approval. Profit remittance is not FX-constrained; the only statutory hurdles are company-law distribution tests (positive net assets, the SARL's audited annual accounts, and the shareholders' meeting resolution) and the domestic 15% dividend withholding tax, which can be reduced to 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive where the qualifying 10% EU shareholding and 12-month holding period are satisfied.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Luxembourg has no statutory surrender obligation, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation timeline for export proceeds. The SARL may freely invoice in EUR or any foreign currency, retain export receipts in any currency, and use those balances for working capital, FX hedging, or reinvestment without BCL notification or declaration beyond standard balance-of-payments statistical reporting thresholds where applicable.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (BCEE/Spuerkeess)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: HIGH for operational clearing, multi-currency collections, and cross-currency payments: Airwallex Luxembourg S.A., a CSSF-authorised electronic money institution, provides SEPA/IBAN capability and SWIFT-compatible payment rails. LOW for statutory capital escrow and any credit function: an EMI is not a credit institution, cannot accept deposits in the prudential sense, does not benefit from the Luxembourg deposit-guarantee scheme for client balances, and must safeguard client funds in a segregated account held at a licensed credit institution. The SARL must therefore keep its statutory subscribed capital and core treasury relationships at a fully licensed credit institution; the EMI rail is a complementary operating channel.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance of all authorised signatories and material UBOs is the default mandate for Luxembourg credit institutions onboarding a newly formed SARL; the initial compliance interview is ordinarily conducted in person at the bank's premises. Remote onboarding via video-identification is possible within the CSSF AML/CFT framework, but banks typically condition it on supplementary notarised and apostilled certification of director signatures and passports. Non-resident directors without an EU identity document should expect biometric verification, certified translations, and a documented source-of-funds file.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Undisclosed or opaque beneficial-ownership chain using non-EEA intermediate entities
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RBE (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs) extract; certified articles of association; notarised shareholders' register; group organigram; UBO passports with certified translations; proof of residential address; professional source-of-wealth memorandum.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Low-substance SARL expecting disproportionately high 3PL turnover, creating perceived shell risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed client warehousing and kitting agreements; warehouse lease or signed sub-contract with a warehouse operator; payroll and social-security enrolment records; open-item receivables and payables ageing; most recent annual financial statements filed with the Luxembourg RCS.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade counterparty or payment flows involving high-risk or sanctions-adjacent jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed counterparty KYC file; commercial invoices and purchase orders; CMR waybills and customs clearance records; Incoterms; OFAC and EU sanctions screening results from a professional screening tool; written business-rationale memo.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid round-tripping or pass-through flows without discernible economic substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 12-month cash-flow forecast; intercompany services agreement with OECD transfer-pricing documentation; purchase-order-to-invoice-to-payment audit trail; warehouse-management-system inventory movement reports; quarterly proof of physical dispatch.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use SWIFT MT103 with UETR for non-EEA shareholder remittances or SEPA Credit Transfer for EUR injections, with Field 70 narrative clearly stating 'EQUITY CONTRIBUTION' or 'SHAREHOLDER LOAN / COMPTE COURANT D'ASSOCIÉ'. ISO 20022 purpose codes must be mapped to the BCL balance-of-payments classification distinguishing direct-investment equity from intercompany debt, and any applicable BCL statistical declaration is based on transaction thresholds. The receiving bank will require the notarised board resolution authorising account opening and capital injection, the RCS extract, the RBE extract, and source-of-funds evidence from the shareholder's own bank account. Pre-wire sanctions screening and a pre-advice to the relationship manager are mandatory to avoid onboarding delays.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rails: (i) SEPA Credit Transfer for EUR supplier settlements within the EEA; (ii) SWIFT MT103 with UETR for non-EEA and non-EUR payments; (iii) ACH Direct for USD disbursements to US suppliers and contractors; (iv) documentary Commercial Letters of Credit governed by ICC UCP 600, reserved for high-value or first-time supplier relationships. All payments must be matched to the underlying purchase order and invoice, with the payment narrative referencing the commercial contract and, where relevant, the customs declaration. Airwallex local-currency virtual IBANs may be used for collections and vendor payments, but final cash concentration and statutory capital must settle on the ledger of the licensed Luxembourg credit institution.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX spot contracts (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP) for immediate settlement of trade payables and receivables
Deliverable FX outright forwards up to 24 months, documented under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement and subject to EMIR reporting and margin rules where applicable
FX swaps combining spot and forward exchanges to manage short-term EUR/USD liquidity mismatches
Cross-currency interest rate swaps for structural shareholder-loan exposure between EUR and USD

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for documented trade payables in restricted onshore currencies such as CNY and INR, only where the counterparty bank maintains an NDF book and the underlying commercial exposure is verified

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of statutory annual accounts (comptes annuels) and management report with the RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (LBR/RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months after financial year-end (calendar-year SARL: by 31 July of the following year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil fine up to EUR 15,000; RCS may issue formal order; three consecutive years of default trigger administrative strike-off (radiation d'office).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Consolidated corporate tax return (déclaration d'impôt) for corporate income tax, municipal business tax, and net wealth tax
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD / Luxembourg Inland Revenue)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 May for the preceding calendar year; extended to 12 November if filed by a registered tax adviser or chartered accountant
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late default interest at 0.6% of unpaid tax; administrative fine up to EUR 5,000; tax recovery orders and enforced collection measures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of beneficial owner (UBO/RBE) status and information
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (LBR-RBE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Mandatory confirmation each calendar year by 30 June; all significant shareholdings changes reported within 1 month of the transaction
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine for directors of EUR 1,250 to EUR 5,000 per violation; entity may also be fined; non-filing may lead to negative mention in RCS extracts.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent statutory audit for an SARL if it exceeds two of the three following thresholds at two consecutive balance-sheet dates: balance sheet total EUR 4.4 million; net turnover EUR 8.8 million; average number of full-time employees 50.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP (Comptabilités et états annuels sous le plan comptable normalisé) is compulsory for standalone statutory accounts; EU-adopted IFRS may be used for consolidated accounts and, under specific article election, for statutory accounts of larger companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each SARL must file an initial UBO return with the RBE and thereafter confirm annually no later than 30 June that its disclosed beneficial ownership remains unchanged; any shareholding transfer or change in beneficiary status must be reported within one month. Managing directors also obtain annual written UBO declarations from every shareholder to substantiate the RBE filing.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of shareholders (registre respectant les parts nominatives)
Minutes of annual general meeting and shareholders' resolutions
Minutes of management board decisions (decision files)
UBO statement and source documents for RBE filings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,800 – USD 5,500 (registered office, corporate domiciliation, RCS filing support, and annual meeting facilitation)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 – USD 15,000 (SCPA or approved statutory auditor fee for a small-to-medium SARL; varies with corporate structure and consolidation complexity)

stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions
